verse.verse_1: Verily We! We sent Nuh Unto his people saying: warn thy people ere there come Unto them torment afflictive.
verse.verse_2: He said: O my people! verily I am Unto you a warner manifest.
verse.verse_3: Worship Allah, and fear Him, and obey me.
verse.verse_4: He will forgive you your sins, and will defer you to an appointed term. Verily the term of Allah when it cometh shall not be deferred, if ye but knew.
verse.verse_5: He said: my Lord! verily have called my people night and day.
verse.verse_6: And my calling hath only increased them in fleeing.
verse.verse_7: And verily so oft as I call them, that Thou mayest forgive them, they place their fingers into their ears, and wrap themselves with their garments, and persist, and are stiff-necked.
verse.verse_8: Then verily have called Unto them publicly:
verse.verse_9: Then verily spake Unto them openly, and secretly also I addressed them.
verse.verse_10: And I said: ask forgiveness of your Lord; verily He is ever Most Forgiving.
verse.verse_11: He will send the heaven upon you copiously;
verse.verse_12: And He will add Unto you riches and children and will appoint Unto you gardens and will appoint Unto you rivers.
verse.verse_13: What aileth you that ye expect not in Allah majesty!
verse.verse_14: And surely He hath created you by stages.
verse.verse_15: Behold ye not in what wise Allah hath created seven heavens in storeys.
verse.verse_16: And hath placed the moon therein for a light, and hath made the sun a lamp?
verse.verse_17: And Allah hath caused you to grow from the earth as a growth.
verse.verse_18: And thereafter He will cause you to return thereinto, and He will bring you forth a forthbringing.
verse.verse_19: And Allah hath made the earth Unto you an expanse.
verse.verse_20: That of it ye may traverse the ways open.
verse.verse_21: Nuh said. my Lord! verily they have disobeyed me and followed them whose riches and children have only increased them in loss.
verse.verse_22: And who have plotted a tremendous plot
verse.verse_23: And who have said: ye shall not leave your gods; nor Shall ye leave Wadd nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth, nor Ya'uq nor Nasr.
verse.verse_24: And surely they have misled many. And increase Thou these wrong-doers in naught save error.
verse.verse_25: And because of their misdeeds they were drowned, and then they were made to enter a Fire. Then they found not for themselves, beside Allah, any helpers.
verse.verse_26: And Nuh said: my Lord! leave not upon the earth of the infidels one inhabitant.
verse.verse_27: Verily if Thou shouldst leave them, they Will mislead Thine bondmen and will beget not save sinning infidels,
verse.verse_28: My Lord! forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house as a believer, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin!
